results.title: Unsigned receiverDestination lets the data service redirect GraphTallyCollector payouts
results.test_command: cd graphprotocol-contracts/packages/horizon && export ARBITRUM_RPC_URL="<arbitrum rpc url>" && forge test --match-path test/UnsignedRavPayoutDestinationPoC.t.sol --fork-url "$ARBITRUM_RPC_URL" --fork-block-number 460062146
results.notes: Arbitrum fork at block 460062146. Same signed RAV accepted with attacker receiverDestination. 20,000,000 GRT escrow drained, 19,800,000 GRT reached attacker after 1 percent protocol cut, provider balance and stake unchanged.
